Name: Festive Slimes
Author: TehPers
Description:
[size=5][b]This mod is outdated and currently has no plans to be updated.[/b][/size][u][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][/u]
[b]Requires SMAPI v2.10.1+ / SDV 1.3.32 and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3256]Teh's Core Mod[/url]
Not multiplayer compatible (most likely)[/b]

This mod replaces slimes to be more festive throughout the year:
[list]
[*]During the fall, slimes are replaced with pumpkin slimes and drop candy
[*]During the winter, slimes have santa hats
[*]During pufferchick's birthday, slimes become pufferchick slimes (credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38947035]Opalie[/url] for the texture)
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3256]Teh's Core Mod[/url]﻿

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
